en.headline: Development Bureau proposes twin landmark towers and more homes at Hung Hom harbourfront
en.dek: The revised plan raises total floor area by 3 per cent to 206,500 square metres, with residential share at 62 per cent, and cancels four waterfront residential blocks for open space.
body: The Development Bureau has submitted a revised proposal for the Hung Hom Station surroundings and harbourfront redevelopment to the Legislative Council, increasing total gross floor area by about 3 per cent to 206,500 square metres.

Under the updated plan, residential development would account for around 62 per cent, or 129,400 square metres, while commercial uses including retail and hotels would take 33 per cent and yacht club facilities the remaining 5 per cent. The bureau said the higher residential share responded to market feedback questioning demand for large-scale offices.

Two interconnected landmark buildings of 184 metres and 236 metres would rise along the waterfront, with the linking space designed as a public viewing platform overlooking Victoria Harbour. Four residential blocks previously planned on the waterfront would be dropped, with the sites turned into public open space connected to yacht berthing facilities.

The government said the target of making the sites available for development in early 2029 remains unchanged. It plans to consult the Town Planning Board, the Harbourfront Commission and relevant district councils on the proposal by the end of 2026.

zh.headline: 發展局建議紅礎海濱建雙塔地標 增加住宅比例
zh.dek: 修訂方案將總樓面增至約20.65萬平方米，住宅佔約62%，臨海四幢住宅改作公眾休憩用地，目標2029年初交地。
body: 發展局向立法會提交紅礎站周邊及海濱發展的修訂建議，整個項目總樓面面積較早前方案增加約3%，至約20萬6,500平方米。
最新建議中，住宅用途佔約62%，即約12萬9,400平方米；商業用途（包括零售及酒店）佔33%；遊艇會設施佔5%。發展局表示，調高住宅比例是回應市場對大規模辦公室需求的意見。
臨海將興建兩幢分別高約184米及236米的相連地標大樓，連接空間可作觀景平台，飽覽維港景色。原擬在臨海用地興建的四幢住宅大廈將取消，改劃為公眾休憩用地，並連接遊艇停泊設施。
政府指，無論採用何種推展模式，2029年初交付土地的目標維持不變，並計劃於2026年年底前諮詢城規會、海濱事務委員會及相關區議會。
